question: Indo-Greek kings ruled which of the following part of ancient India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Northwest.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The Indo-Greek Kingdom, or the Graeco-Indian Kingdom, known historically as the Yavana Kingdom (Yavanarajya), was a Hellenistic kingdom covering various parts of Afghanistan and the northwest regions of the India
